name: How does AKN Design Group ensure safety during structural modifications?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group ensure safety during structural modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: Safety is paramount in all structural modifications undertaken by AKN Design Group. We ensure safety through a multi-faceted approach that includes engaging certified structural engineers for all load-bearing alterations, meticulously planning temporary support structures during construction, and strictly adhering to all local building codes and regulations. Our experienced team follows rigorous safety protocols on-site, and all work is subject to required municipal inspections. This managed process, backed by our decades of experience, ensures the integrity of your home and the safety of everyone involved.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group prioritizes safety by involving certified structural engineers, using temporary supports, adhering to building codes, and conducting rigorous on-site safety protocols and inspections.
